name: Lion Visitant
source: Pathfinder #152: Legacy of the Lost God

generalAbilities.name: Lifesense (Imprecise) 60 feet
generalAbilities.description:
See rules...

Lifesense allows a monster to sense the vital essence of living and undead creatures within the listed range. The sense can distinguish between the vitality energy animating living creatures and the void energy animating undead creatures, much as sight distinguishes colors.

defensiveAbilities.name: Void Healing
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

A creature with void healing draws health from void energy rather than vitality energy. It is damaged by vitality damage and is not healed by vitality healing effects. It does not take void damage, and it is healed by void effects that heal undead.

defensiveAbilities.name: Whip Vulnerability
defensiveAbilities.description: A lion visitant takes 7 Slashing Damage{7} additional damage from whips.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pack Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The visitant deals an extra 1d4 damage to any creature that's within reach of at least two of the visitant's allies.

offensiveAbilities.name: Pounce
offensiveAbilities.description: The visitant Strides and makes a Strike at the end of that movement. If the visitant began this action Hidden, it remains hidden until after the ability's Strike.

offensiveAbilities.name: Roar
offensiveAbilities.description:
The visitant lets out a loud and horrifying roar. Each creature within 100 feet must attempt at a DC 19 Will Saving Throw save.

No matter the result, affected creatures are then temporarily immune to the effect for 1 minute.

Note: A DC was not provided for this ability by Paizo. The DC present here is a moderate DC for the creature level according to the Gamemastery Guide creature building Tables.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature is Frightened 1.

Failure The creature is Frightened 2.

Critical Failure The creature is Frightened 3.

offensiveAbilities.name: Sneak Attack
offensiveAbilities.description: The visitant deals an extra 1d8 precision damage to Off-Guard creatures.

offensiveAbilities.name: Grab
offensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Requirements The monster's last action was a successful Strike that lists Grab in its damage entry, or the monster has a creature Grabbed or Restrained

Effect If used after a Strike, the monster attempts to Grapple the creature using the body part it attacked with. This attempt neither applies nor counts toward the creature's multiple attack penalty.

The monster can instead use Grab and choose one creature it's grabbing or restraining with an appendage that has Grab to automatically extend that condition to the end of the monster's next turn.
